subject: Junior Civil Engineer application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I've applied through SEEK for the Junior Civil Engineer role at Castle Hill and wanted to send a short note to the careers inbox as well, since the website asks for CVs there.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026 (road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards) and before that worked on site in the Philippines for about a year as project-in-charge and field engineer: drawing reviews, inspections, quality checks and site records. That is a little under the one to two years the ad asks for, and I'd rather say so plainly.

I hold a White Card, a driver's licence with my own transport, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Sydney.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077

letter.subject: Application for Junior Civil Engineer
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Junior Civil Engineer role advertised on SEEK. Excel's site teams look after quality, safety and environmental management on road, drainage, excavation and concreting work, on jobs such as the Rhino Reserve at Taronga Zoo and Henson Park. Supporting a site team with drawings, checks and records is what I did on site before I came to Australia to study, and a family company that keeps people long term, as the ad describes, is where I'd like to be.

In the Philippines in 2019 and 2020 I was project-in-charge on a community hall renovation, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewing structural and architectural drawings, checking work against them and running inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. I then worked as a field engineer on subdivision finishing works, keeping site reports, material records and progress reports and coordinating with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers. That is about a year of site experience in total, a little under the one to two years the ad asks for.

Since then I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026, which is where I learned to read and prepare Australian civil drawings: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. My Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019) covered construction methods and project delivery.

I use Word and Excel; I have not used Microsoft Project yet. I hold an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, a White Card, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Sydney.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Happy to talk it through by phone.
